explanation: Matches MathWorld's Harmonic Series page and Boppana, arXiv:2007.11017: Borwein, Bailey and Girgensohn asked whether the sum over positive integers n of (2/3+(1/3)sin n)^n/n converges, and Boppana proved it does. Summability over ℕ+ with n in radians is this series; the terms are nonnegative, so summability is equivalent to convergence. The book itself was not read. MathWorld and Boppana both quote the question.
